gate_policy: No final acceptance or best-architecture claim while any required stage is not PASS

slam_pose_graph.evidence: Independent ORB + RGB-D PnP 596 frames, 9 verified nonlocal constraints; optimized SE3 pose-graph ATE RMSE 0.05498m, RPE@30 0.04777m on TUM fr1_desk. Custom VO, not RTAB-Map.
slam_pose_graph.not_yet: Multi-sequence accuracy and physical robot localization

tsdf_reconstruction.evidence: Dense 596-frame 3cm TSDF: 49,442 vertices, 90,058 faces and 48,490 surface points, colored 15mm object point map; independent scanned GT surface proximity measured on annotated RGBD-Scenes v2 scene11/14, but scene14/11 used dataset camera poses.

occupancy_navigation_ready.evidence: No calibrated floor and Nav2 collision test

object_reidentification_gt.evidence: Real RGB-D Scenes v2 provides per-point semantic class GT, not physical instance IDs; colorized persistent UUID candidates are not independently validated. Cannot report GT IDF1/3D instance AP.

semantic_vlm.evidence: SmolVLM-256M-Instruct real inference: 24 confirmed candidate objects, up to two images per object; 12 descriptions lexically consistent and persisted, 12 quarantined, zero physical-ID changes. No GT semantic accuracy.

nav2_integration.evidence: Actual ROS2 Jazzy nav2_planner ComputePathToPose succeeded (status=4) with 30 poses for object UUID target on reconstructed gravity-aligned TUM occupancy; no robot control/localization and no NavigateToPose.

tsdf_odd_frame_surface_consistency.scope: same-sequence withheld depth frames, not independent scene GT

real_semantic_pipeline_smoke.source: yolo11n-seg pretrained; SmolVLM on selected views
real_semantic_pipeline_smoke.scope: technical integration only; physical ID not validated

nav2_jazzy_global_planner_smoke.scope: ComputePathToPose on offline TUM map; synthetic base pose; robot not moved

vlm_24_object_multiview_inference.scope: CPU inference and lexical quarantine, not GT semantic correctness

gt_3d_semantic_14scene_ablation.data: RGB-D Scenes v2 point class GT; scenes1–10 train vs11–14 test
gt_3d_semantic_14scene_ablation.limits: Point semantic class only, no physical GT ID

actual_rgbd3d_semantic_gt_two_scenes.data: Real 3DMatch RGB-D frames with official RGB-D Scenes v2 3D point semantic labels
actual_rgbd3d_semantic_gt_two_scenes.limits: No GT physical instance identities; GT poses in input, no SLAM score
